nodes.description: StakingV2.deposit(uint256 _depositId, uint256 _amount) public; validates amount, calls internal _deposit which writes balances/totalStaked, then performs external token.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount) while a plain 'locked' bool flag is toggled.

StakingV2._deposit(address _sender, uint256 _depositId, uint256 _amount) internal nonReentrant; computes currentBalance/finalBalance via calcRewards, updates totalStaked, balances, depositDates and emits Deposited.
StakingV2.withdrawAll(uint256 _depositId) external; requires balanceExists, validDepositId, not paused and lockup expired, then calls _withdrawAll.

StakingV2._withdrawAll(address _sender, uint256 _depositId) internal nonReentrant; zeroes balances then calls external tokenReward.transferFrom(liquidityProvider(), _sender, finalBalance) guarded only by the 'locked' bool.
StakingV2.extendLockup(uint256 _depositId) external; requires balance, valid id != 1, not paused, then calls _extendLockup.
StakingV2._extendLockup(address _sender, uint256 _depositId) internal nonReentrant; recomputes compounded balance and rewrites totalStaked, balances and depositDates.

StakingV2.calcRewards(address _sender, uint256 _depositId) public view; derives timePassed from _now() minus depositDates, selects ratio/lockPeriod per deposit id and computes compounded balance via compound().
StakingV2.compound(uint256 _principal, uint256 _ratio, uint256 _n) public view; A = C(1+rate)^t using ABDKMath64x64 divu/mulu and pow.
StakingV2.pow(int128 _x, uint256 _n) public pure; binary exponentiation over ABDKMath64x64 fixed point values.
StakingV2.isLockupPeriodExpired(uint256 _depositId) public view; compares _now() against depositDates[msg.sender][_depositId] plus a hardcoded lock period.
StakingV2.getCurrentBalance(uint256 _depositId, address _address) public view; reads balances[_address][_depositId].
StakingV2._now() internal view; returns block.timestamp (used for deposits, withdrawals, lockups and reward accrual).
StakingV2._setLocked(bool _locked) internal; writes the 'locked' state variable used as a weak mutual-exclusion flag.
StakingV2.setLiquidityProviderAddress(address _address) public onlyOwner; two-step parameter update with PARAM_UPDATE_DELAY timelock stored in liquidityProviderAddressParam.
StakingV2._paramUpdateDelayElapsed(uint256 _paramTimestamp) internal view; time-based comparison using _now() and PARAM_UPDATE_DELAY.
StakingV2.initializeStaking(address,address,address,address) external initializer; wires owner, token, tokenReward and liquidity provider address and transfers ownership.

StakingV2.claimTokens(address _token, address payable _to, uint256 _amount) external onlyOwner; native send/Sacrifice fallback, STAKE token balance check against totalStaked, or SafeERC20 transfer of arbitrary token.
StakingV2.pauseContract(bool value) public onlyOwner; toggles contractPaused.
StakingV2.pauseDepositAndLockupExtensions(bool value) public onlyOwner; toggles pausedDepositsAndLockupExtensions.
StakingV2.liquidityProviderAddress() public view; returns param.newValue from liquidityProviderAddressParam.
StakingV2.senderCurrentBalance() public view; returns msg.sender.balance (native ETH balance).
bool locked; weak reentrancy flag toggled around external token transfers.
bool contractPaused; global pause switch.
bool pausedDepositsAndLockupExtensions; selective pause switch.
uint256 totalStaked; aggregate staked principal tracked against token balance in claimTokens.
mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) balances; per-user per-deposit-id balances.
mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) depositDates; timestamps of deposit/withdraw/lockup extension.
IERC20Mintable token; the STAKE token address used for deposits and balance checks.
IERC20Mintable tokenReward; reward token pulled from the liquidity provider address on withdrawal.
AddressParam liquidityProviderAddressParam; pending/current liquidity provider address with timelock timestamp.
address _owner (Ownable); owner address backing the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for balances, depositDates, transferFrom source and ownership checks.
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time source returned by _now() and used for reward/lockup math.

External call token.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount) in deposit; account state was already updated by _deposit before this call and protection relies on a plain 'locked' bool set after _deposit returns.

External call tokenReward.transferFrom(liquidityProviderAddress(), _sender, finalBalance) in _withdrawAll; recipient and amount are attacker-influenced and the call happens after state mutation with only bool-lock protection.
_to.send(_amount) low-level native transfer in claimTokens with a Sacrifice selfdestruct fallback.
SafeERC20 low-level call (callOptionalReturn -> address(token).call(data)) performed on an arbitrary owner-supplied token inside claimTokens.
uint256 _depositId parameter selecting the deposit mode (1..5).
uint256 _amount parameter of deposit(); amount to be pulled from the sender.
address _sender parameter of the internal _deposit/_withdrawAll/_extendLockup helpers.
currentBalance local: pre-existing balance for a deposit id.
finalBalance local: compounded balance computed by calcRewards.
timestamp local: value of _now() captured for events and depositDates.
timePassed local in calcRewards: _now() - depositDates.
ratio local in calcRewards: interest rate selected by deposit id.
lockPeriod local in calcRewards/isLockupPeriodExpired: lockup duration per deposit id.
daysCount local in compound(): _n divided by DAY.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used by deposit as the depositor and as the transferFrom source.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of token.transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as _sender into _deposit and keys balances/depositDates.
msg.sender is passed as _sender into _withdrawAll and used as reward recipient.
isLockupPeriodExpired reads depositDates[msg.sender][_depositId].
msg.sender is passed as _sender into _extendLockup.
_now() returns block.timestamp directly.
calcRewards derives timePassed from _now(), so reward amounts depend on miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
Lockup expiry check is bound to block.timestamp via _now().
_deposit stores _now() in depositDates and the event timestamp.
_extendLockup resets depositDates with _now().
_withdrawAll emits _now() and reward math depends on elapsed time.
setLiquidityProviderAddress stores _now() as the parameter update timestamp.
_paramUpdateDelayElapsed branches on _now() versus PARAM_UPDATE_DELAY.
deposit() invokes _deposit(msg.sender, _depositId, _amount) before the token transfer.
deposit() toggles the 'locked' flag through _setLocked around the external transfer.

Balances and totalStaked are written inside _deposit before the external token.transferFrom, and the only guard is a plain bool flag set afterwards, allowing a malicious token to reenter deposit paths.
deposit reads/writes the locked state variable through _setLocked.
_deposit calls calcRewards(_sender, _depositId).
_deposit calls getCurrentBalance(_depositId, _sender).
_deposit calls _now() for depositDates and event data.
_deposit updates totalStaked with add/sub on finalBalance and currentBalance.
_deposit writes balances[_sender][_depositId].
_deposit writes depositDates[_sender][_depositId].
withdrawAll() delegates to _withdrawAll(msg.sender, _depositId).
withdrawAll() requires isLockupPeriodExpired(_depositId).
_withdrawAll toggles the 'locked' flag around the reward transfer.
_withdrawAll performs an external tokenReward.transferFrom from the liquidity provider after mutating balances, guarded only by the boolean lock.
_withdrawAll calls calcRewards(_sender, _depositId).
_withdrawAll calls getCurrentBalance(_depositId, _sender).
_withdrawAll calls _now() for the WithdrawnAll event.
_withdrawAll resolves the reward source via liquidityProviderAddress().
_withdrawAll zeroes balances[_sender][_depositId].
extendLockup() delegates to _extendLockup(msg.sender, _depositId).
_extendLockup calls calcRewards(_sender, _depositId).
_extendLockup calls getCurrentBalance(_depositId, _sender).
_extendLockup calls _now() to timestamp the extension.
_extendLockup rewrites totalStaked as totalStaked + finalBalance - currentBalance.
_extendLockup writes balances[_sender][_depositId] = finalBalance.
_extendLockup writes depositDates[_sender][_depositId].
calcRewards calls compound() for each accrual segment.
calcRewards reaches pow() indirectly through compound().
calcRewards calls getCurrentBalance(_depositId, _sender).
calcRewards calls _now() to derive timePassed.
calcRewards reads depositDates[_sender][_depositId].
compound() relies on fixed-point multiplication and pow() exponentiation, the core arithmetic of the reward formula A = C(1+rate)^t.
isLockupPeriodExpired reads depositDates[msg.sender][_depositId].
isLockupPeriodExpired calls _now() for the expiry comparison.
setLiquidityProviderAddress consults _paramUpdateDelayElapsed(param.timestamp).
setLiquidityProviderAddress writes param.timestamp = _now().
setLiquidityProviderAddress reads and rewrites liquidityProviderAddressParam.
_paramUpdateDelayElapsed compares _now() with the stored timestamp plus delay.
initializeStaking configures the liquidity provider address through setLiquidityProviderAddress.
initializeStaking assigns the STAKE token address into token.
initializeStaking assigns the reward token address into tokenReward.
initializeStaking seeds and then transfers ownership, writing _owner.
claimTokens pushes native value to an owner-supplied address via _to.send / Sacrifice selfdestruct, handing control to an external address.
claimTokens invokes SafeERC20, which performs a raw address(token).call(data) into a caller-specified token contract.
claimTokens reads token.balanceOf(address(this)) when the claim token is the STAKE token.
claimTokens subtracts totalStaked from the contract token balance to bound the claimable amount.
pauseContract writes contractPaused.
pauseDepositAndLockupExtensions writes pausedDepositsAndLockupExtensions.
_setLocked writes the locked state variable.
claimTokens is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender with _owner.
pauseContract is gated by onlyOwner, i.e. by _owner.
pauseDepositAndLockupExtensions is gated by onlyOwner, i.e. by _owner.
setLiquidityProviderAddress is gated by onlyOwner, i.e. by _owner.
liquidityProviderAddress reads liquidityProviderAddressParam.newValue.
getCurrentBalance reads balances[_address][_depositId].
senderCurrentBalance returns msg.sender.balance, exposing caller-controlled input directly.
token.transferFrom is invoked on the token state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The _depositId parameter is only meaningful inside deposit() where it selects the deposit mode (1..5) and indexes the balances/depositDates mappings.
The _amount parameter is consumed by deposit() which forwards it to _deposit and to token.transferFrom.
The _sender parameter of the internal _deposit helper is just the caller identity used to key balances and depositDates, so it folds into _deposit.
currentBalance is a transient local of _deposit used to reconcile totalStaked, with no independent semantics.
finalBalance is produced by calcRewards and immediately persisted by _deposit into balances/totalStaked.
The timestamp local is simply the value returned by _now() and carries no separate meaning.
timePassed is a derived local of calcRewards computed as _now() - depositDates; it exists only for the reward calculation.
ratio is a constant lookup local in calcRewards selected by deposit id and passed straight into compound().
lockPeriod is a constant lookup local in calcRewards/isLockupPeriodExpired tied to the deposit id branching.
daysCount is the per-call conversion of seconds to days inside compound() and has no meaning outside that computation.
